entries.theoremStatement: For monic irreducibles of degree n over F_q, I_q(n) = (1/n) * sum_{d|n} mu(d) q^(n/d).
entries.finiteFieldObject: degree shell of monic irreducible polynomials in F_q[t]
entries.integerAnalogue: prime number theorem scale pi(x) ~ x/log x
entries.statusForLoop: known calibration, not a discovery target
entries.promotionRisk: Known theorem on the finite-field side and known/asymptotic theorem on the integer side; cannot be promoted as new.
entries.nextUse: Use only as a sanity check for irreducible table construction and normalization.

experimentEligibility.reason: No honest open integer analogue that can seed an experiment.

entries.theoremStatement: For monic degree shells, sum_{deg F=n} mu(F) is 1 at n=0, -q at n=1, and 0 for n>=2.
entries.finiteFieldObject: all monic polynomials of fixed degree
entries.integerAnalogue: Mertens/PNT-style cancellation is not a complete-family identity over Z
entries.statusForLoop: exact calibration, no honest transport as an experiment
entries.promotionRisk: The exact zero is caused by the rational zeta function of F_q[t]; an integer partial sum is not the same object.
entries.nextUse: Use as a guard against treating complete-family cancellation as an integer-prime discovery.

experimentEligibility.reason: No honest open integer analogue that can seed an experiment.

entries.theoremStatement: For odd q, polynomial Mobius parity is (-1)^deg(F) times the quadratic character of Disc(F), with zero on repeated-root cases.
entries.integerAnalogue: no coefficient-space discriminant character controls integer primality or integer Mobius values
entries.promotionRisk: This explains finite-field Mobius parity but was already rejected because the coefficient-neighborhood object has no honest Z analogue.
entries.nextUse: Use only for finite-field mechanism explanation and novelty audits.

experimentEligibility.reason: No honest open integer analogue that can seed an experiment.

entries.theoremStatement: In characteristic 2, Berlekamp/Artin-Schreier-style discriminant data replaces the odd-characteristic quadratic discriminant character.
entries.finiteFieldObject: Berlekamp discriminant / trace data over characteristic-2 coefficient space
entries.integerAnalogue: no direct integer counterpart to characteristic-2 Artin-Schreier trace parity
entries.promotionRisk: A characteristic-2 mechanism can be exact and still be non-transportable to Z.
entries.nextUse: Use as a guard against mixing q=2 effects into an alleged integer law.

experimentEligibility.reason: No honest open integer analogue that can seed an experiment.

entries.theoremStatement: For fixed degree n and fixed distinct shifts, the normalized Mobius autocorrelation over monic degree-n polynomials tends to 0 as q grows.

entries.integerAnalogue: Chowla correlations for integer Mobius/Liouville shifts
entries.statusForLoop: proof-target family, not a numeric-discovery family

entries.nextUse: If pursued, write a proof-obligation map from finite-field character sums to an integer substitute before running more data.
